description: Source code for the Potentials module in a CRM system, defining the Potentials class with methods for managing potential records, relationships, and reports.

classes.name: Potentials
classes.description: CRMEntity subclass managing potential records, relationships, and reports in a CRM system.

methods.name: Potentials
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Builds SQL query for listing potential records with optional ordering and filtering.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds SQL query for exporting potential records in CSV format.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to a potential record.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities (tasks/events) related to a potential record.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a potential record.

methods.name: get_stage_history
methods.description: Fetches sales stage change history for a potential.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves task and event history related to a potential.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Retrieves quotes linked to a potential.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Retrieves sales orders associated with a potential.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from multiple entities to a target record.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary SQL query part for reporting involving potentials.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Unlinks all dependent entities of a potential record.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationship between a potential and another entity.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves related modules (contacts, products, etc.) linked to a potential.
